Hi Mina —

Thanks for the invite. We ran into a calendar conflict on 4/8 (several execs are tied up in licensing reviews) and need to explore alternatives. Our procurement lead is only available earlier that week and prefers consolidated sessions for contracting touchpoints.

Quick ask: can you propose a plan that lets us cover the product roadmap + a short technical demo for our engineering leads across two shorter windows instead of a single half-day? If procurement can join only one block, we need a clear callout of when commercial/contract items will be discussed.

Also, any pre-read you can share would help our staff prepare.

—Alyssa

Sr. Director, Platform Ops
Crestline Health

Subject: Re: Renewal QBR — "straddle" mini-sessions + procurement checkpoint

Alyssa — thanks for the heads up. We can absolutely make this work and be explicit about the procurement window. Proposal below (short and focused):

Plan (two short, linked sessions):
- Session A — Roadmap + business impact (40 mins)
  - Audience: Exec sponsors + product owners
  - Goal: confirm priorities for next 12 months and outcomes tied to cost/latency SLOs
- Session B — Technical demo + integration Q&A (50 mins)
  - Audience: Engineering leads, SRE, PMs
  - Goal: architecture walkthrough, runtime/ops questions, migration/lift plan
- Procurement checkpoint (20 mins) — scheduled as an add-on to the end of Session A or a 20-min standalone with Procurement only

Suggested calendar candidates (PST):
- Option 1: Tue 2026-04-06 — Session A 10:00–10:40, Session B 11:10–12:00 (procurement 10:40–11:00)
- Option 2: Wed 2026-04-07 — Session A 14:00–14:40, Session B 15:10–16:00 (procurement 14:40–15:00)

Attachments: QBR-mini-session-plan-v2.pdf (high-level agenda + attendee list) — sending with this thread.

Can you confirm:
1) Which of the two options looks better for your execs?
2) Who from procurement should we invite to the 20-min checkpoint (name + email)?
3) Any mandatory agenda items (e.g., data residency, SOC2 evidence, SSO/SCIM) you want prioritized?

If those dates don't work at all, we can expand to the prior week and block a single consolidated 90-min session for execs + procurement.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Lead — Renewals
Redwood Inference

Mina — this is great, thanks. Option 1 looks closest but we have a hard constraint: our Head of Proc, Danica Lee, can only do the morning of 4/6 until 11:00. Please schedule procurement 10:40–11:00 as you proposed.

Attendees for procurement:
- Danica Lee <danica.lee@crestlinehealth.com> (Head of Procurement)
- procurement@crestlinehealth.com (placeholder for legal ops)

Mandatory items:
- Contracting timeline through signature (expectation: we want an 8-week procurement window)
- Data retention and audit log retention details (SOC2 paths)

We'd like the technical demo to focus on the migration path from our current hosted provider, particularly KV cache behavior, cold-starts, and canary/fallback policies. Our SRE lead (Ben Carter) will be on Session B.

Alyssa
